answers.explanation: Disks hold everything too big or too long-lived for main memory.
Programs and data come from disk, so a slow disk subsystem slows everything.
A good order avoids moving the heads back and forth.
Free-space management, storage allocation, and disk scheduling are the three main activities.
Optical disks and tape are slow, cheap, and used for backups and archives.
A WORM disc can be written once and then only read.
It still must be managed, by the OS or by applications like backup programs.
